title: Change delivery target
purpose: Change or remove the order’s agreed delivery target with an attributed reason, without altering analytical holding times.

items.label: Chain of custody / Client / Project
items.description: Identifies the order; all its requested tests share this delivery target.

items.label: Current target
items.description: Existing local timestamp or not set.

sections.title: Fields and actions
paragraphs: If the order changed since opening, the form refuses a stale update and retains submitted input on the error page. Reload and compare its current target before trying again.

items.label: Delivery target
items.description: Optional new date/time in the configured laboratory zone; blank marks unscheduled. It must differ from the current value. There is no automatic target calculation from project turnaround.

items.label: Reason
items.description: Required explanation kept with old/new target, actor and timestamp.

items.label: Change delivery target
items.description: Custodians, project managers and administrators update the order then return to its detail page. Cancelled orders must be reinstated first.

items.label: Cancel
items.description: Returns to the order without saving.

items.label: History
items.description: Chronological reschedule events show old/new targets and their reasons. No changes yet means no rescheduling event; the initial target was set at creation.
